issues_confirmed: Repo contains zero source files. Only reference.md, todo.md, last_run.json and .gitignore are tracked; `find . -type f` outside .git returns exactly those four.
The dataset the project exists to analyze is absent: `my_spotify_data/` and `spotify_data.local.json` do not exist, and `git status --ignored --short` returns empty (no ignored files at all).

reference.md:15 documented the project's only entry point as a python3 one-liner loading `my_spotify_data/Spotify Technical Log Information/BoomboxPlaybackSession.json` — a path that does not exist, so the command fails with FileNotFoundError.
todo.md:5 ('Keep raw exports ignored') was a policy statement, not a task, and was already satisfied by .gitignore:26.
todo.md:7 ('Filter invalid timestamps') presupposed a parser that was never written (todo.md:3, also never done).
.gitignore:30 is a blanket `*.json` with only `!last_run.json` exempted (line 31), which would silently ignore package.json, tool configs, or any committed schema fixture.
last_run.json:8-12 had total_files, total_size_mb, total_events_real and date_range all set to 'redacted' by commit ea364b7, leaving the repo with no record of its own dataset's shape.
No commits since 2026-05-30 (both commits are same-day); all 8 todo.md items untouched for ~16 weeks.

verdict_rationale: The idea is sound and unoriginal in the good way — personal Spotify export analysis is well-trodden and genuinely doable. It is not redundant with another repo and it is not a bad thought, so RETIRE would be overreach. But REVIVE would be dishonest: there is no code, and the export is not on disk, so no 'smallest end-to-end thing that works' can be written or tested this session. Writing a parser against a schema that cannot be verified is exactly the architecture-without-working-software this tier warns about. The blocker is crisp and external: obtain the export (up to 30 days) and pick one concrete question. Until both hold, there is nothing to build.
